description: This file defines the Ext.ux.Reorderer class, a base class for handling reordering of UI items in Ext JS 3.2.1. It sets up default configurations, event handling, and abstract methods for reordering logic and drag-and-drop creation, meant to be extended for specific reordering implementations.

classes.name: Ext.ux.Reorderer
classes.description: A base class for enabling reordering of UI items with event handling and abstract methods for specific reordering logic.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the Reorderer with optional configuration, applying defaults.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with a target component and sets up reorderable items.

methods.name: reorder
methods.description: Reorders items based on a mapping object, firing events before and after.

methods.name: doReorder
methods.description: Abstract method to perform the actual reordering; must be overridden in subclasses.

methods.name: createItemDD
methods.description: Abstract method to create a drag-and-drop object for an item; must be overridden.

methods.name: createItemDD
methods.description: Sets up a toolbar item as draggable, with drag behavior defined.

methods.name: createIfReorderable
methods.description: Creates a drag-and-drop instance for an item if it is reorderable.

methods.name: getItems
methods.description: Returns the array of items to be made draggable; default is the target's items.

methods.name: initEvents
methods.description: Adds before-reorder and reorder events to the target component.
